templates.name: Bootstrap Platform
templates.description: One-time platform setup: Vaultwarden, Ntfy, the reverse proxy, Authentik, Uptime Kuma, Prometheus + Grafana and PBS, in that order. Re-runnable, but it is a bootstrap — run it once, then use the per-app jobs.

templates.name: Config Doctor
templates.description: Check config/proxmox.yml, config/infrastructure.yml and every config/apps/*.yml against the variable-loading contract. Names every missing or malformed key by file and key path in one pass. Read-only: it changes nothing, contacts no service, and is safe to run at any time.

templates.name: Configure App
templates.description: Create or edit config/apps/<instance>.yml without an SSH session. Every field is an OVERRIDE: anything left blank keeps its current value, and anything absent from the file falls through to the app defaults. The previous content is kept under config/apps/.backups/ and the task log shows a unified diff of what changed. Anything not covered by the fields below goes in Extra YAML.

survey_vars.name: instance
survey_vars.title: Instance name
survey_vars.description: This IS the filename, the guest hostname and the subdomain: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (e.g. radarr, radarr-4k).

survey_vars.name: stack
survey_vars.title: Stack (Docker apps)
survey_vars.description: Which shared stack host to place this app on, e.g. media_stack. Blank keeps the current value.

survey_vars.name: network
survey_vars.title: Network (native LXC apps)
survey_vars.description: A named network from config/proxmox.yml. Blank keeps the current value.

survey_vars.name: vmid
survey_vars.title: VMID
survey_vars.description: Explicit Proxmox VMID. Required only on a dhcp network.

survey_vars.name: cores
survey_vars.title: vCPUs
survey_vars.description: Blank keeps the current value or the app default.

survey_vars.name: memory
survey_vars.title: RAM (MB)
survey_vars.description: Blank keeps the current value or the app default.

survey_vars.name: disk
survey_vars.title: Disk (GB)
survey_vars.description: Blank keeps the current value or the app default.

survey_vars.name: port
survey_vars.title: Port
survey_vars.description: Set only when running two instances of the same app on one stack host.

survey_vars.name: subdomain
survey_vars.title: Subdomain
survey_vars.description: Hostname on the lab domain. Blank means: use the instance name.

survey_vars.name: identity
survey_vars.title: Identity mode
survey_vars.description: none = no Authentik object; catalog = a launch tile, the app keeps its own login; oidc = the app signs in through Authentik; forward_auth = Authentik login enforced at the reverse proxy.

survey_vars.name: proxy
survey_vars.title: Reverse proxy
survey_vars.description: Which reverse proxy publishes this app. Blank keeps the current value.

survey_vars.name: access
survey_vars.title: Access
survey_vars.description: Who may reach this app. internal restricts the route to reverse_proxy.internal_cidrs; public opens it to every source address — on a WAN-facing reverse proxy that means the internet. Blank keeps the current value.

survey_vars.name: estate
survey_vars.title: Estate
survey_vars.description: Multi-domain labs only: the named estate from infrastructure.yml. Blank uses the default estate.

survey_vars.name: extra_yaml
survey_vars.title: Extra YAML
survey_vars.description: Any other instance keys, as YAML. Deep-merged last, so it wins over the fields above.

survey_vars.name: reset
survey_vars.title: Reset instead of merge
survey_vars.description: false merges over the existing file (the normal case). true discards it and writes only what this survey specifies; the old content is still kept under .backups/.

templates.name: Get Config
templates.description: Read the lab definition off the runner without an SSH session. With no instance it returns everything authored; with one it returns that file. The task log is always redacted, so it is safe to copy out of the UI. It also writes an unredacted tar.gz restore point under artifacts/ on the runner and prints its path.

survey_vars.name: instance
survey_vars.title: Instance
survey_vars.description: One app instance to return, e.g. radarr-4k. Blank returns the whole authored set plus the archive.

survey_vars.name: archive
survey_vars.title: Write the archive
survey_vars.description: Write the tar.gz restore point under artifacts/. Defaults to true when no instance is given.

templates.name: Deploy Vaultwarden
templates.description: Deploy or update Vaultwarden (native LXC). Re-running is the update path.

templates.name: Deploy Ntfy
templates.description: Deploy or update Ntfy, the notification hub every other job reports to (native LXC).

templates.name: Deploy Caddy
templates.description: Deploy or update Caddy, the reverse proxy every app route is written to (native LXC).

templates.name: Deploy Authentik
templates.description: Deploy or update Authentik, the SSO provider (Docker on its own core_stack host).

templates.name: Deploy Uptime Kuma
templates.description: Deploy or update Uptime Kuma. Every later app deploy registers its own monitor here.

templates.name: Deploy Observability
templates.description: Deploy or update Prometheus + Grafana as one app (Docker on monitoring_stack).

templates.name: Deploy PBS
templates.description: Deploy or update Proxmox Backup Server (VM) and configure the backup schedule.

templates.name: Remove App
templates.description: Stop an app and unwire it from the reverse proxy, Authentik, Uptime Kuma and DNS. config/apps/<instance>.yml is kept as the restore point; no guest is destroyed.

survey_vars.name: instance
survey_vars.title: Instance
survey_vars.description: App instance name, e.g. radarr-4k

survey_vars.name: app
survey_vars.title: App (only if the instance was renamed)
survey_vars.description: Leave blank unless the instance name differs from the app name, e.g. instance radarr-4k of app radarr

survey_vars.name: delete_data
survey_vars.title: Delete data
survey_vars.description: false keeps volumes and data paths so a re-deploy restores the app; true wipes them

templates.name: Lab Status
templates.description: Read-only overview: guests, containers, pending native app updates, uptime monitors and PBS snapshots. Changes nothing and sends no notification.

templates.name: Check Native App Updates
templates.description: Compare installed vs latest release for every native LXC app and notify via Ntfy. Notifies only — re-run an app's deploy job to update it.

templates.name: Restart App
templates.description: Restart a native LXC app via its lab-restart-app script. Notifies via Ntfy.

survey_vars.name: instance
survey_vars.title: Instance
survey_vars.description: App instance name, e.g. vaultwarden

templates.name: Tail App Log
templates.description: Stream recent log lines from a native LXC app into this job's console.

survey_vars.name: instance
survey_vars.title: Instance
survey_vars.description: App instance name, e.g. vaultwarden

survey_vars.name: lines
survey_vars.title: Lines
survey_vars.description: How many log lines to show (default 50)

templates.name: Rollback Container
templates.description: Pin a Docker app to an earlier image tag and recreate it. Run this when a Watchtower update breaks something. Notifies via Ntfy.

survey_vars.name: stack
survey_vars.title: Stack
survey_vars.description: Stack tag the container runs on, e.g. media_stack

survey_vars.name: container
survey_vars.title: Container
survey_vars.description: App instance name — its Compose project is /opt/<instance>

survey_vars.name: image_tag
survey_vars.title: Image tag
survey_vars.description: Tag to roll back to, e.g. 5.1.3. Leave blank to re-pin the tag already in the Compose file.

templates.name: Wire Media Stack
templates.description: Wire the media stack's app-to-app connections: every *arr registered in Prowlarr for indexer sync, every download client registered in the apps that speak its protocol, and Bazarr pointed at Sonarr and Radarr. Idempotent — safe to re-run. Notifies via Ntfy.
